capabilities: Catch a random Pokémon on task closes
Level up and evolve a partner Pokémon
Browse, search and filter the Pokedex
disambiguation: Not a general Pokémon reference; it only tracks the Pokémon you catch by closing tasks.
extras: Unofficial fan project with no Pokémon artwork bundled; sprites are downloaded from PokeAPI only when the user presses a button and must not be redistributed. The Starter pack is once per install, tracked in the plugin's data.json. Desktop only, Obsidian 1.13 or later.
problem: Closing tasks in Obsidian gives no reward or feedback, so there is little pull to keep finishing them.

relations.evidence: Built to work alongside TaskNotes and Sheiko Task Lifecycle.
Built to work alongside TaskNotes and Sheiko Task Lifecycle.
Pokémon data (names, types, evolutions, moves) comes from PokeAPI.

summary: Gamified companion for TaskNotes that catches a random Pokémon when tasks close, with a partner that gains XP, levels up and evolves.
